fields.label: Default to Goose on SUPER+A
fields.description: Automatically select the Goose agent model whenever the AI Sidebar opens.

fields.label: Context Refresh Interval (seconds)
fields.description: How often open windows and active folder context refresh while the AI Sidebar is open.

fields.label: Screenshot Capture Area
fields.description: Default target when taking a screenshot for Goose vision analysis.

fields.label: Auto-Attach Screenshot on Every Prompt
fields.description: Automatically capture and attach a screenshot whenever you send a message to Goose.

fields.label: Dedicated Vision Model (Optional)
fields.description: If set (e.g. gemma-4-26b-a4b-vision), screenshots/uploads are analyzed by this model first so text-only Goose models still get vision.

fields.label: Vision API Base URL
fields.description: OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint for the dedicated vision model (e.g. http://localhost:4000/v1 or http://<host>:4000/v1).

fields.label: Vision API Key (Optional)
fields.description: Bearer token for your LiteLLM / vision endpoint (leave empty if using OPENAI_API_KEY).

fields.label: Goose Execution Mode
fields.description: Controls GOOSE_MODE passed to the agent (auto executes tools immediately).

fields.label: Built-in Extensions
fields.description: Comma-separated Goose built-in extensions passed to --with-builtin.

fields.label: Share All Open Windows
fields.description: Include every open window across workspaces, not just the focused window.

fields.label: Max Agent Turns
fields.description: Safety limit for tool-call loops per prompt (--max-turns).

fields.label: Goose Binary Path
fields.description: Executable name or absolute path to the goose CLI.
